project.description: jdk.m3.intern (module org.m3jdk.intern): the owner-scoped primitive intern space M3InternSpace (ByteStore, TupleStore, GraphStore over 64-KiB byte and 8,192-long pages, page-bounded Arrays.mismatch collision checks, the deterministic insertion-order archive with magic M3IS version 1), the typed structural shapes M3InternShapes, the prefix-sharing lexical path trie M3InternPathTrie and the bounded SHA-256 archive container M3InternArchiveGuard. Pure Java 21, java.base only. The typed, bit-exact canonical literal pool M3CanonicalLiteralPool (nine named kinds as CONSTANT tuples of one space; a pool only, never a JVM constant-pool or ldc replacement) is relocated the same way by recipe/canonical-literals-20261106 from develop b259ec9f5606; its ten donor JUnit tests run in the test phase.
